content.answer: Fix rule: when updating a single-select (or any id-referenced) option list in Feishu Bitable, never send a name-only list that rebuilds options — instead merge by stable id: pass through the original option objects (same id + name) for all existing names, assign fresh ids only to genuinely new names, continuing from max(existing id) + 1; rebuilding the list by name alone gives every option a brand-new id and silently clears/breaks the option references in all existing data rows.
content.reuse_advice: For any id-referenced catalog update: treat ids as immutable keys. Always merge — keep existing entries' original ids and pass their original objects through unchanged; only append new entries with new ids continuing from max(existing id)+1. Never replace a catalog by names alone: the backend will re-issue ids and every existing row referencing the old ids will silently lose its value.
